concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-manage-reserve-account]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace reserve-account guide for liable-holder-linked collateral against transfer-caused negative user balances, distinct from refund/chargeback compensation.
warnings: Insufficient available reserve funds cause the proposed negative-balance transfer to fail. The reserve account covers transfer-caused deficits, unlike the reserved compensation account for refund/chargeback deficits; collateral blocking is not payout or bank-receipt proof.
